summary: End-to-end test of LionCity AI-Logistics (FR-01..FR-20). Backend: 29/29 pytest cases passed covering Hub Managers/Drivers/Vehicles/Zones CRUD + phone uniqueness, Orders creation/clustering/auto+manual assign/status+proof, Routing (all 3 modes with Python fallback since OSRM blocked as expected), GPS simulate-step, Shipper inbox, LTA passthrough endpoints. Frontend: all 8 nav pages load, 4 Orders tabs switch correctly, role switcher works, map with markers/zones/incidents renders. No 500s, no console errors, no broken flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1075 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; recommend splitting into routers/ modules per FR group (hub_managers, drivers, vehicles, zones, orders, routing, lta) for maintainability.
update_hub_manager filters None values but update_driver does not — minor inconsistency.

osrm_route/osrm_trip use timeout=6s — in this env OSRM is always unreachable, so every routing call pays the 6s network delay before fallback. Consider a feature flag to skip OSRM in this environment to speed up responses.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers.
test_credentials: N/A — auth explicitly skipped per spec
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/seed (2 hub managers, 6 drivers, 6 vehicles, 3 zones, 15 orders). Autouse pytest fixture reseeds once per session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite. OSRM is unreachable in this env — /api/routing/plan falls back to pure-Python NN-TSP with synthetic geometry (CBD detour for avoid_erp). All 3 routing modes return valid distance_m/duration_s/geometry/ordered_order_ids. LTA passthrough endpoints work. Frontend public URL: https://reverent-noyce-9.preview.emergentagent.com.
